7.7.1.2 Monitor status and UDS status update
Status bit processing is an essential part of the Dem functionality. SWCs or BSW mod-
ules frequently report monitor results via the API Dem_SetEventStatus. A call of
these functions will trigger the status bit processing of the Dem.
According to ISO 14229-1[2] monitor, event or DTC status cannot be used to control
safety critical functionality. There are various situations e.g. enable conditions or the
UDS service ControlDTCSetting that can block processing of these status information.
[SWS_Dem_01278]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04067
⌈The Dem shall provide a monitor status per event to store current monitor state infor-
mation. The monitor status contains the information as defined in Dem_MonitorSta-
tusType.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01279]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04068
⌈The Dem shall perform the counter based event debouncing synchronously within the
context of the calling Dem_SetEventStatus function.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01280]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04067
⌈Upon call of Dem_SetEventStatus and after debouncing, the Dem shall process the
monitor status in the same manner as the UDS status:
• Bit0 (TestFailed) according to [SWS_Dem_00386]
• Bit1 (TestNotCompleteThisOperationCycle) according to [SWS_Dem_00394].
The monitor status byte processing shall be done synchronously within the context of
the calling Dem_SetEventStatus function.⌋
